resources.string: 1. Turn on Khmer Keyboard in the system settings.
2. Choose it as the keyboard to type with.

The globe key switches between three ways of typing. Hold it to change to another keyboard.

ខ្មែរ: a Khmer layout. Press the parts of a syllable in any order; they are stored in the correct order. Hold a key for the character in its corner.

Singkhmer: spell Khmer words with Latin letters, with a space after each word: nh jg tv sala rean. Press space twice, or tap a suggestion, to finish the phrase.

English: plain Latin letters. Used by itself for passwords, email and web addresses.
